Name: Pet Store
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][size=5][u]About[/u][/size][size=3]
The pet adoption shop is built when you open the shop in-game, which means that if you set trade item's they'll apply for every pet in the shop.
This mod enables adding trade items to individual pet breeds by reading the CustomFields for Data/Pets, check the guide for more info on the format to get it set up.

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/PetStore/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]Guide available on the GitHub[/url].

[/size][size=5][u]Known Issues[/u][/size][size=3]
The game renders trade item's that are too big in the player inventory, this is an issue with trade item's in general and not something I'm gonna consider trying to fix at the moment (hopefully someone else will).

[/size][size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][size=3]
Hopefully none, but let me know.

[/size]
